title: Copy style
description: The source of the MusherCopy Vale style and of the MusherProse Vale package that ships it (definitions/copy/style.yml, EC-0038). `conventions generate` writes one Vale rule per entry in rules, the package's .vale.ini from adopted, and the copy block of index.json.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape. Always 1.

package.description: The Vale package's name: the release asset <package>.zip, whose root directory has the same name.

style.description: The Vale style the rules below make up.

formats.description: The file extensions copy is written in: those Vale reads natively, and component templates with the format Vale reads each as once [formats] maps it.

adopted.description: Published Vale packages the package installs beside its own styles, each pinned to one release. `whole` styles are applied by the consumer's BasedOnStyles (COPY-03); `rules` styles contribute only the rules they enable.

rules.description: The style's own rules: only what no adopted package covers, and only what holds for any site's copy.

reason.description: Why the rule is turned off or on, written beside it in the package's .vale.ini.

package.description: The release asset Vale downloads: a URL that names the version, never a bare package name, which resolves to the latest release.

use.description: whole: every rule applies, less those disabled. rules: only the rules enabled apply.

disable.description: Rules of a whole style that do not apply, each with its reason.

enable.description: The rules a `rules` style contributes, each with its reason.

name.description: The rule's file name without .yml, and its name in alerts: <style>.<name>. A requirement whose validation.style names it links its alerts.

extends.description: The Vale rule type. Only existence rules are authored here.

level.description: The level Vale reports at, matching the severity of the requirement that names the rule.

note.description: Why the rule is shaped as it is, written as a comment in the generated file.

tokens.description: Regular expressions (Vale's regexp2 syntax), matched case-insensitively on word boundaries.
